Story 01 · Live app

Designing my home
with an AI copilot

Choosing materials for my new flat meant checking hundreds of supplier samples against a strict brief. So I built an assistant to do it.

Renovation AI Agent
Before · ID render
After · AI
01 · Collect

30 real products, scored

I pasted supplier catalogue links. The agent found 30 real laminates, each with its code, colour and finish, and scored every one against my brief.

02 · Check

12 approved, 4 schemes

My brief said "zero wood". AI judges style, but a hard rule in code removes anything wood, even if the AI likes it. The 12 that passed became 4 whole-kitchen schemes.

03 · See it

Try it on the real design

My ID gave me a 3D render. The agent repainted it with the chosen scheme, keeping the layout and lighting, so I could see real materials before deciding. Drag to compare.

Story 02 · Personal system

80 bank statements,
one calm answer

My money was scattered across 5 banks and I kept worrying whether I was on track for the house, the wedding and a car. So I pulled it all together.

Personal Finance Pipeline
Illustrative data
01 · Gather

80 PDFs, 5 banks

Every statement I had, including scanned ones with no readable text.

02 · Read and check

Every number reconciled

Each statement is read and checked against its own printed totals, so nothing is silently dropped.

03 · Protect

Private details removed

Names, account numbers and ID numbers are stripped before anything is summarised.

04 · Decide

One dashboard

Spending trends, categories, and progress towards each big milestone, all in one place.
